ledger.x: 1892: Britain declares the Gilbert Islands a protectorate (27 May to 17 June 1892): Captain Davis 'made the sixteen islands of the Gilbert Islands a British protectorate'.
1892: the Ellice Islands become a protectorate: 'Between 9 and 16 October of the same year [1892], Captain Herbert Gibson of HMS Curacoa declared the Ellice Islands to be a British protectorate.'
1900: Ocean Island (Banaba) 'had been hastily added to the protectorate in 1900'.
1908: the government's headquarters moves to Ocean Island ('In 1908, the government's headquarters was moved to Ocean Island').
1916: the Union Islands (Tokelau) join the colony: 'During the year 1916, the Union Islands (Tokelau) were also annexed to the Gilbert and Ellice Islands colony.'
1916: the protectorate becomes a Crown Colony: 'On 12 January 1916, the islands' status was changed to that of a Crown Colony.'

1916: the northern Line Islands, annexed in 1888, are included in the colony: 'To this was added Ocean Island on 27 January 1916, along with the northern Line Islands', 'which included Washington (Teraina) and Fanning (Tabuaeran)'.
1919: Christmas Island is annexed to the colony: 'On 28 November 1919, Great Britain reasserted its claim to Christmas Island and annexed it to the colony.'

1926: the Union Islands pass to New Zealand's administration: 'In 1925, Great Britain asked New Zealand to accept responsibility'; 'On 11 February 1926, an Order in Council transferred responsibility for administration of the Union Islands'.
1937: the Phoenix Islands are annexed: 'On 18 March 1937, Great Britain annexed the uninhabited Phoenix Islands.'
1941: Japan occupies the Gilbert Islands: Japan 'occupied the Gilbert Islands on 9-10 December 1941', 'three days after the attack on Pearl Harbor'.
1943: the Battle of Tarawa opens on 20 November 1943: 'the Battle of Tarawa on 20-23 November 1943'.
1943: the Battle of Tarawa ends on 23 November 1943 with the island in American hands.

1943: the Japanese occupation of the Gilbert Islands ends with the Battle of Tarawa (20 to 23 November 1943); the Gilbert and Ellice Islands infobox gives '1945: Japanese occupation of the Gilbert Islands'.
1975: the Ellice Islands separate (1 October 1975); the colony is known as the Gilbert Islands until independence in 1979.

1975: the Ellice Islands separate from the Gilbert Islands: 'On 1 October 1975, legal separation from the Gilbert Islands (now Kiribati), took place'; 'Tuvalu became an independent constitutional monarchy... on 1 October 1978'.
1979: the Gilbert Islands become independent as Kiribati on 12 July 1979: 'The Gilbert Islands attained independence on 12 July 1979 under the name Kiribati.'

wars.outcome: Japan 'occupied the Gilbert Islands on 9-10 December 1941'; the Battle of Tarawa and Makin began on 20 November 1943 ('the Battle of Tarawa on 20-23 November 1943').
